ad_library.summary: No active Meta ads were found for Varahi Energies. Meanwhile four Hyderabad installers - Evergrid Energy, Solox Energies, Truzon Solar and Punarvi Energies - are all live this week buying the same homeowner with Rs. 78,000-subsidy offers. Varahi's MNRE-approved track record (250+ projects, 700 kW+ PM Surya Ghar, 80 MW PM-KUSUM assistance) is not in front of any paid traffic.

funnel.meaning: Every enquiry arrives as a chat message. There is no email capture anywhere on the site, so nobody who does not reply can be followed up with, and nothing can be retargeted or measured.

findings: No active Meta ads under your name - four Hyderabad installers are buying the same homeowner this week with the same Rs. 78,000-subsidy message.
Every CTA on the site is a WhatsApp deep link. There is no email capture, so a visitor who does not reply cannot be followed up with, and no audience can be built.

MNRE-approved vendor with 250+ projects, 700 kW+ of PM Surya Ghar work, a 545 kW commercial rice-industry plant and 80 MW of PM-KUSUM assistance - the proof exists, it just is not in front of paid traffic.
Head office is in Nizamabad with the Hyderabad branch in Kompally, but there is very little Hyderabad-specific content for local search demand (Kompally, Secunderabad, Kukatpally).
next_steps: Turn WhatsApp into a funnel, not a dead end
Keep WhatsApp as the reply channel, but capture name, phone and locality on the site first, so non-repliers can be followed up.
Test paid lead gen in Hyderabad
Start with a small Meta budget on one residential offer. Your four competitors are already proving the demand exists in this city.
Kompally, Secunderabad and Kukatpalli pages with real project photos - free local search traffic sitting next to the traffic you would be buying.
Your site already displays a live generation widget (8.4 kW, 94%, 32 units today). That is a trust asset most installers do not have - put it on the homepage.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
